page: JWT Authentication Helper for encoding, decoding, signing, verifying. Import: {decode, sign, verify} from 'hono/jwt'. Functions: sign(payload, secret, alg?) returns Promise<string>, verify(token, secret, alg, issuer?, aud?) returns Promise<payload>, decode(token) returns {header, payload}. Algorithms: HS256/HS384/HS512 (HMAC), RS256/RS384/RS512 (RSASSA), PS256/PS384/PS512 (RSASSA-PSS), ES256/ES384/ES512 (ECDSA), EdDSA. Default algorithm: HS256. Payload claims: exp (expiration), nbf (not before), iat (issued at), iss (issuer), aud (audience). Verification: checks exp, nbf, iat, iss, aud. Errors: JwtAlgorithmNotImplemented, JwtTokenInvalid, JwtTokenNotBefore, JwtTokenExpired, JwtTokenIssuedAt, JwtTokenIssuer, JwtPayloadRequiresAud, JwtTokenAudience, JwtTokenSignatureMismatched. Example: const token = await sign({sub: 'user123', exp: Date.now()/1000 + 300}, secret). decode() no verification, inspect only. Questions: How to sign? How to verify? How to decode? Which algorithms? What claims? Error types? Payload validation?

sections.manifest: Import statements for JWT helper. import {decode, sign, verify} from 'hono/jwt'. Related: JWT Middleware also uses this. Questions: What to import?

sign() function for generating JWT tokens. Signature: sign(payload, secret, alg?) returns Promise<string>. Parameters: payload (required, any object), secret (required, string key), alg (optional, algorithm like HS256). Default alg: HS256. Returns: signed JWT token string. Example: const token = await sign({sub: 'user123', role: 'admin', exp: Date.now()/1000 + 300}, secret). Payload claims: sub (subject), role (role), exp (expiration). Questions: How to sign? What parameters? Default algorithm? Payload format?

verify() function for validating JWT tokens. Signature: verify(token, secret, alg, issuer?, aud?) returns Promise<payload>. Parameters: token (required), secret (required), alg (required, HS256/RS256/etc), issuer (optional, string|RegExp), aud (optional, string|string[]|RegExp). Validates: signature, exp, nbf, iat, iss, aud. Returns: decoded payload. Example: const payload = await verify(token, secret, 'HS256'). Throws: on invalid signature or failed validation. Questions: How to verify? What parameters? Claim validation? Error handling?

decode() function for inspecting JWT tokens without verification. Signature: decode(token) returns {header, payload}. No verification performed. Returns: header object and payload object. Example: const {header, payload} = decode(token). Use case: inspect token without validating. Security: only for debugging, don't use for auth. Questions: How to decode? Verification? Use cases?

Payload validation claims during verify(). exp (expiration): checks token not expired. nbf (not before): checks not used before time. iat (issued at): checks not issued in future. iss (issuer): checks trusted issuer. aud (audience): checks intended recipient when configured. Validation automatic: if claims present, checked. Required: include claims in payload if validating. Questions: Which claims validated? How automatic? What claims required? What's aud?

Custom JWT error types for error handling. JwtAlgorithmNotImplemented: algorithm not supported. JwtTokenInvalid: token format invalid. JwtTokenNotBefore: token used before nbf time. JwtTokenExpired: token expired (exp claim). JwtTokenIssuedAt: iat claim incorrect. JwtTokenIssuer: iss claim incorrect. JwtPayloadRequiresAud: aud claim required but missing. JwtTokenAudience: aud claim mismatch. JwtTokenSignatureMismatched: signature invalid. Questions: Error types? How to catch? What each means?

Supported JWT algorithms. Symmetric: HS256, HS384, HS512 (HMAC SHA-*). Asymmetric: RS256, RS384, RS512 (RSASSA), PS256, PS384, PS512 (RSASSA-PSS), ES256, ES384, ES512 (ECDSA), EdDSA. Algorithm selection: depends on key type. HMAC: symmetric key (HS*). RSA: public/private key (RS*, PS*). ECDSA: EC key (ES*). EdDSA: Ed25519 key. Questions: Which algorithms? HMAC vs RSA? ECDSA difference? EdDSA support?
